page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for high-compute workloads. It features 128 dedicated physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at 2.9 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 752.0 GB of RAM, providing 5.88 GB of memory per core. Graphics processing is handled by four bundled NVIDIA A10 GPUs based on the Ampere architecture, delivering a combined 96 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, meaning external block storage must be attached.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates strong multi-core processing capabilities, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 123,935.69. Memory performance is highly efficient, showing a read-only small block bandwidth of 6,856.96 GB/sec and a large block write speed of 103.09 GB/sec. Multi-threaded decompression is a notable strength, with bzip3 decompression reaching a top-tier score of 575.13 GB/sec. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, while database operations are highlighted by a Redis SET throughput of 100.72 million operations per second.

The instance offers high resource density, combining massive dedicated CPU cores with multiple enterprise GPUs, which represents a highly capable hardware profile for parallel processing. However, the lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs depending on the storage tier selected. Given its hardware profile, this server is suited for GPU-accelerated workloads, deep learning inference, high-performance computing, large-scale data processing, and multi-threaded simulation tasks.
